source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC console introspect target user D-Bus object, run `ipmitool user list 1`, and compare UserPrivilege.
source_snapshot.criteria: UserPrivilege matches between D-Bus and IPMI.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; hardcodes root/channel 1 and treats D-Bus introspection as a value read using insecure SSH.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW; requires actual D-Bus property, exact username/object/IPMI user ID/channel and vendor role-to-privilege normalization.

old_problem: D-Bus introspection describes interfaces rather than necessarily returning the current privilege value; root and IPMI channel 1 were unapproved assumptions. The same account and firmware-specific role-to-IPMI privilege translation were not bound.
disposition_reason: Both queries are read-only and the equality method is clear. ED-03/15/20 allow username/object path, IPMI channel/user ID and role-translation table as project configuration. Reading the actual property and exact user row, then normalizing auxiliary flags, removes the need for further engineering classification.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2243, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2244 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00026-V001 / cd9265adbf65de4a was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind one approved account to its username, encoded D-Bus object path/service/interface/property, IPMI channel and numeric user ID; root/channel 1 are examples only.
Use `busctl get-property` or documented equivalent to read the actual role/privilege value; retain introspection only as schema corroboration.
Capture complete `ipmitool user list <approved-channel>` output and map the exact target row by user ID/name.
Normalize D-Bus role and IPMI numeric/name privilege through the signed firmware-specific table, including enabled/callin/link-auth/IPMI-message flags when they affect effective access.
An absent IPMI account may pass only under an explicit expected no-access/unsupported rule; asynchronous propagation needs an approved steady-state wait, not blind retry.
Use trusted protected console access and redact unrelated account data; do not change users, passwords or privileges.
No login, busctl/ipmitool query, account mutation, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: D-Bus and IPMI effective user privilege equivalence
test_case.purpose: Verify that one approved BMC account's actual D-Bus role and its channel-specific IPMI user-table privilege represent the same effective access under the signed platform translation.
required_package: Target username, encoded object path, service/interface/property
IPMI channel and user ID/name mapping
Firmware-specific D-Bus role-to-IPMI privilege and auxiliary-flag translation
Trusted protected console and evidence-redaction policy
test_case.test_command: On the verified BMC, read the approved user's actual D-Bus role/privilege property and the complete IPMI user list for the approved channel, bind the exact IPMI user row by ID/name, preserve stdout/stderr/exit, normalize both through the signed role/flag translation, and compare effective access without mutation.
test_case.expected_result: The D-Bus object and IPMI row identify the same account, all queries succeed, and the normalized D-Bus role equals the IPMI privilege/effective-access state including required auxiliary flags.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact cross-interface identity, actual property value, exact channel/user row and equality under the approved map. Interface metadata, hardcoded root/channel, same-looking name on another row or unapproved absence cannot pass. Missing mapping blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Verify exact BMC, account/object/channel/user ID and signed translation before comparison.
Read-only busctl/ipmitool operations only; no user/password/role/channel mutation.
Protect console credentials and redact unrelated account details.
Stop on missing/duplicate account, wrong channel, permission error or ambiguous translation.
expected_evidence: Complete redacted D-Bus property and IPMI user-list stdout/stderr/exit
Signed role/privilege/auxiliary-flag translation and normalized comparison
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On identity or mapping failure, close the session and preserve evidence; do not edit privileges or accounts to force agreement.

source_conflict.reason: The row consistently requires one user's privilege equivalence across D-Bus and IPMI; placeholders are configuration inputs.

blocked.reason: Read-only interfaces and comparison are clear; identity/translation bindings are parameterizable.
